chapters.title: Biodiversity and Classification
chapters.main_concept: Introduces the three-domain system and the taxonomic hierarchy, surveys the kingdoms of Eukarya, animal phyla and vertebrate classes, and outlines how viruses are classified. Closes with biodiversity levels, sampling methods for distribution/abundance, and species concepts and modes of speciation.

chapters.title: Cells and Subcellular Organelles
chapters.main_concept: Treats the cell as the basic unit of life, the cell theory with its validation and exceptions, and light vs electron microscopy. Describes cell wall, plasma membrane and every major organelle, contrasts prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, then covers cell signalling, membrane transport and stem cells.
